title: Idempotency and retries: turning at-least-once into effectively-once
summary: Idempotency keys, server-side dedupe, exponential backoff with jitter, the thundering herd, and how the outbox + inbox patterns close the dual-write gap.
crux: How to make every retry-safe POST cost the user exactly one outcome, even when the network swallows the response.
keytakeaway: True exactly-once is impossible on a network. Production gets there via at-least-once delivery + idempotent processing (server dedupe by key + outbox/inbox patterns) + jittered retries — observable behavior is exactly once.
